name: terraform-release-state
description: GitHub Action for Terraform state storage using GitHub Release assets

scripts.build: trap 'rm -rf .build' EXIT; tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp .build/src/main.mjs .build/src/main.js && rm -f dist/index.mjs dist/index.mjs.map && ncc build .build/src/main.js --minify --source-map
scripts.test: trap 'rm -rf .test-build' EXIT; tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.mts
